name: Laikou Sakura Mud Mask 5gm x 6 Pack
description:
Laikou Sakura Mud Mask – 5g x 6 Pack

🌸 Brightening | Pore Cleansing | Hydrating

Product Type: Facial Mud Mask
Volume: 5g x 6 Pack (Total 30g)
Origin: Made in Japan

Key Benefits:

Brightens Skin: Fights uneven skin tone and restores natural glow.

Glowy Complexion: Helps achieve the rosy, radiant skin admired in Japanese beauty.

Pore Care: Deeply cleanses pores, minimizes their appearance & controls excess oil.

Hydrating Formula: Provides intense moisture, leaving skin soft and supple.

Nourishing Care: Enriched with sakura extract to deliver vital nutrients for healthier skin.

Features:

✔ Convenient individual 5g packs – easy to use & travel-friendly
✔ Suitable for all skin types
✔ Can be used 2–3 times a week for best results
✔ Dermatologist tested

✅ Best For: Dull skin, uneven tone, large pores, oily skin, dry pa
